caption: A dog walks into its doghouse and a moment later pokes its head back out of the doorway.

sa.check: A dog walks into its doghouse.
A moment later it pokes its head out of the doorway.
The dog is out of sight between going in and looking out.
The entry comes first and the head comes out after.

pc.expect: It is the same dog, and it is out of sight while inside.
pc.fail: A different dog looks out; or two dogs; or the dog appears outside while it is inside.

pc.expect: The head comes out through the doorway only, not through the walls or the roof.
pc.fail: The head comes through a wall; or the body through the roof; or the house passes through the dog.
The head is detached; or its size changes; or it turns into another animal.
It slides; or lifts; or shakes with no dog inside.

pc.expect: One dog and one doghouse keep their number.
pc.fail: The dog splits; or the doghouse duplicates; or the dog merges with the house.

pc.expect: The dog's coat and the doghouse stay the same.
pc.fail: The coat changes pattern; or the doghouse changes colour; or the yard rearranges.

note: The dog is self-driven: when it looks out is its own. Only permanence and the doorway are judged.
